paragraphs: The X3 M is a single-generation model within the F97 chassis, which sits alongside the G01-generation X3. Across its production run, the X3 M has used just one engine — the S58 — a 3.0-litre twin-turbo inline-six petrol engine. The S58 is a genuine engineering fix for the previous S55's rod bearing issues, with a closed-deck block and a well-proven B58 architecture. Both the standard X3 M and the X3 M Competition share this engine, with different power outputs — but the same engine code, rebuild approach and components.
about.boldParagraph: The X3 M Competition is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre twin-turbo inline-six petrol engine fitted to the X3 M across the entire F97 generation (2019–2026). The S58 is a genuine reliability improvement over its predecessor, with no significant defect pattern documented. Genuine BMW M parts carry a documented 30-50% premium over standard components — something worth setting expectations on when budgeting for a rebuild.
